verdict_why.S01: Both are clean walks with the same boy and one flat bat. Wan S01_a passed with nothing to fix, starts smoothly and is 0.5 s longer for a 5.5 s shot. SkyReels pops brighter at 0.21 s and over-colours the cow, although its cow walk and camera move are livelier.
verdict_why.S06: Wan S06_a is the only take with a real hit (2.31 s), and its bat stays one flat piece. SkyReels fast turns the bat into a round baseball bat and glues the ball to his arm. SkyReels full loses the ball, then fills the sky with 2-3 balls, whips the camera round to a "4" on his back and breaks the bat.
verdict_why.S12: SkyReels keeps solid sticks and whole hands in every frame checked, which no Wan take managed (S12_c's sticks flick to stubs between strokes and fray with red smears at 2.79-2.96 s). Its strikes are weaker, mostly one hand per drummer, and the clip is 0.5 s shorter.

overall: Keep Wan 2.1 as the main clip model. Use SkyReels fast for S12, the drummers, once the owner has seen it, and consider it for other shots where thin held props keep dissolving. SkyReels did not solve the batting shot: in both modes it failed worse than Wan (a baseball bat or a broken bat, no hit, extra balls). Its clips are 69 frames (2.875 s) against Wan's 81 (3.375 s), so every hold gets longer. There was one seed (7) per clip, so some of these differences may come from the seed rather than the model. Not checked: other seeds, other shots, and how a SkyReels clip looks after lyric_video.py (upscale, effects, moving hold).
fast_vs_full: Neither is usable for S06. Full (16 steps, guidance 5, the negative on) drew the right flat cricket blade in the backlift, possibly because "baseball bat" in the negative counts only with guidance on, and it swung faster. But from 1.04 s it falls apart (the camera whip, the "4" on his back, a doubled, then bent, then missing bat, the ball gone at 0.54 s and then 2-3 balls, a changed face), and it judders with a repeated frame about every fourth frame. Fast (6 steps, guidance off, no negative) keeps the framing and moves smoothly, but the bat turns into a round baseball bat from about 1.5 s and the ball sticks to his arm. Full costs 4.7 times the GPU time (191 s against 41 s). With one seed each, and the same seed giving completely different motion in the two modes, this does not show that either mode is better in general. If full mode gets another go, try 2-3 seeds; its negative is the only thing that has kept the blade flat.
